translation: The Suwen, the Yellow Emperor says: Now, the heat diseases are all of the class of cold damage. Some heal and some die; that they die is all within six or seven days, and that they heal is all after ten days or more; why is this? Qibo says: The great yang is the category of all the yang; its vessel connects with the Wind Mansion (Fengfu), and therefore it governs the qi of all the yang. When a person is injured by cold, then the disease becomes heat; although the heat is severe, one does not die. But those who are affected by cold twice and fall ill must die. The Emperor says: I wish to hear its appearance.
